svg.title: Event (tp::event): one class at an event, pull by pull

g.text: Event (tp::event): one class at an event, pull by pull
+create(const Rules&, const sled::Params&, span<const int> order) : optional<Event>
+full_pull_m() : double, the pull-off line in a pull-off
test pull: first pull, and the first after every sled change;
100 m <= test < 110 m: line to 110 m, sled stays;
test past the line: heavier by ceil(over / learnt step), at most max steps; the test puller re-pulls;
the operator learns what a step is worth from each change and the next test pull;
test short of the target: lighter (knives out, push-down later; with neither left,
a tenth of the box out a step);
test puller may keep an unchanged or lighter sled's pull: decides after pull +2,
pull-off: full pulls, filled to 4 from 90 m; sled heavier so the strongest stops
at the line; again among those who full-pull again;
disqualified (a tire on the chalk): 0 m, behind every pull that counts;
a disqualified test pull leaves the sled, and the next puller tests it
